com.krosz.klenzer.lifetime.name: Klenzer Pro Lifetime
com.krosz.klenzer.lifetime.reviewNote: Scanning is free. The paywall opens when you tap Fix now or any Clear/Delete button, and from Settings by tapping the Klenzer row (it shows Free scan until unlocked). Lifetime is pre-selected. Restore purchase is on the paywall and in Settings.
